inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment disclosed in FY2025 annual report (CAS) or any IFRS year FY2018-FY2024; EquityAwardTaxes 0 every year. SBC-zero market: SBC rows kept explicit at 0%, house and street bases coincide.
inputs.fx_note: CNY -> HKD 1.1733, Yahoo CNYHKD=X 2026-10-16. All flows, debt and per-share values built in CNY and converted at this rate. Parity check against the A-share dual listing: 600547.SS CNY 26.37 (2026-10-16) x 1.1733 = HKD 30.94 vs the H-share quote; the ~40% A/H premium is normal for an SOE dual listing, so this confirms rate direction only, not a tight tie. Note refresh_price.py never updates fx_rate.
inputs.share_count_basis: 4,609.93m H+A shares after the Sept-2025 H-share placing (136.5m shares at HK$28.58). No convertibles or options outstanding; held FLAT. The placing was genuine non-SBC issuance and is already in the count.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: 10y CGB risk-free 1.8%, China/H-share ERP 7.0%, beta 1.3 (levered gold producer) -> cost of equity 10.9%; pre-tax cost of debt 3.3% (SOE bank and bond funding; FY2025 finance cost CNY1.91bn on ~CNY65bn debt = 2.9%), 25% tax -> 2.5%; target weights 60/40 equity/debt after the 2025 deleveraging placing -> 7.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: cyclicality, production disruption and governance risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities CNY148m sit inside total_debt (parser convention: borrowings + bonds + leases + non-current liabilities due within one year); lease principal NOT deducted from the flows; right-of-use amortisation (CNY118m FY2025) is inside da_pct. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: Attributable-only flows via the leakage driver: cash_tax_rate_path is a COMBINED rate 1-(1-0.30)x(1-0.28) = 49.6% (30% cash tax across PRC 25% / Argentina-Ghana 35% / withholding; 28% non-controlling share of net profit, FY2025 1,887/6,627 = 28.5%, H1 2026 ex-Donghai ~34% distorted by the domestic production dip). NCI stock (CNY20.5bn at 2026-06-30) is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 clean EBIT ~CNY13.7bn x 0.504 = 6.9bn vs reported attributable net profit 4,739 + after-tax, after-NCI finance cost ~0.9bn + one-offs (fair-value, investment and impairment losses ~2.9bn x ~0.55) ~1.6bn = ~7.2bn; ties within noise. Known conservatism: 100% of consolidated capex is charged against 70%-share NOPAT, which overstates the parent's growth-capex burden by ~0.3 x (capex - D&A) in FY2026-29, roughly CNY4-5bn of PV (~CNY1/share, ~HK$1.2); the alternative (NCI at book in the bridge) would understate the NCI claim by about twice that, so leakage was chosen.
inputs.perpetual_bonds_treatment: CNY14,005m of perpetual bonds (CAS: 'other equity instruments', interest CNY507m FY2025 treated as a profit distribution) are economically senior to ordinary shareholders and are deducted in equity_bridge; their interest is excluded from the unlevered flows. Net income and equity in the Metrics CSV include the perpetual holders' share (CAS convention); NetIncomeOrdinary KPI is the ex-perp figure (FY2024 2,494 vs 2,899).
inputs.accounting_basis_note: FY2018-FY2024 history is IFRS; FY2025 onward (and all quarterlies) is PRC CAS. Not like-for-like: FY2024 OCF 20.3bn IFRS vs 13.3bn CAS, capex 27.9bn IFRS vs 20.1bn CAS. FY0 anchors (revenue, capex, D&A, EBITDA) are all taken from the FY2025 CAS statements so the forward build is on one basis.
inputs.mid_cycle_fcf: Gold price normalised from FY2027: base US$3,000/oz (~CNY680/g at 7.05 CNY/USD) vs FY2025 realised CNY794/g (48.4t sold, cost 392/g incl. D&A) and H1 2026 realised CNY1,030/g (19.96t, cost 450/g). Base sits between the 2023-25 average (~US$2,590) and the 2025 average (~US$3,430), i.e. the mid-point rule of the sanity-check skill applied to the gold price rather than to a FCF series that has been negative in 6 of the last 8 years because of growth capex. Bull ~US$3,800 sustained, bear ~US$2,500. FY2026 (year 1) blends the actual H1 2026 at ~CNY1,030/g with an H2 at the scenario's transition price.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md row: operating company, non-US and cyclical) with owner-fcf-adaptations (a) CNY WACC and CNY->HKD quote, (b) leases as debt, (c) NCI via leakage, (d) excluded interest income matched by cash-like assets in the bridge, (e) SBC-zero, (f) risk charged once. Mid-cycle gold normalisation is applied in the driver paths from the first build (not as a post-hoc fix) because FY2025/H1 2026 are peak-cycle prints. Revenue is a poor base for this company (41% externally purchased gold at 0.8% gross margin, 10% small bars at 2.3%) so the paths are set in CNY-billion EBITDA terms and expressed as margins on a pass-through-inflated revenue line; the Y2 revenue drop in every scenario is the pass-through re-pricing to the normalised gold price, not a volume collapse. Price is the HKEX regular close, not after-hours.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: through-cycle volume path (+3-4%/yr self-produced gold from Twin Hills, Sanshandao 15kt/d and Cardinal) at flat real gold; equity 5yr CAGR 9.3% is the method's primary but is inflated by the 2025 gold price and the Sept-2025 placing, and revenue CAGRs are inflated by pass-through purchased-gold volumes
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Revenue 3yr CAGR 27.5% and EPS 3yr CAGR 70% diverge >30% from equity 3yr CAGR 10.9%: the divergence is the gold price cycle (FY2022 trough at ~US$1,800 to FY2025 at ~US$3,430), not an operating trend. FCF CAGRs are undefined: owner FCF was negative in FY2018, FY2020-FY2024 (IFRS) and positive only in FY2019 and FY2025 (CAS), because capex has run 1.8-5.5x D&A every year. Owner FCF series (CNY m, reported FCF - interest income): FY2018 -814, FY2019 53, FY2020 -163, FY2021 -3,923, FY2022 -2,315, FY2023 -1,386, FY2024 -7,787, FY2025 8,411 (CAS; includes +4.9bn payables build).

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 flat: H1 actual CNY53.6bn, H2 at a transition price ~CNY780/g with ~23t sold as domestic mines partially recover. FY2027 -17% is the pass-through (purchased gold ~50t, small bars ~12t) and self-produced gold (49t) re-pricing to the CNY680/g mid-cycle price. FY2028+ +3-4%: self-produced volume 52t -> ~60t by FY2035 (Twin Hills ~5t from H1 2027, Sanshandao expansion, Cardinal) plus ~2% nominal gold drift; pass-through volumes flat.
base.margin_rationale: EBITDA in CNY bn: FY2026 ~21.9 (H1 clean ~13.0 incl. add-back of the CNY705m Donghai loss; H2 ~8.9); FY2027 ~14.9 = 49t x (680-440)/g 11.8 + ~2.0 other gross profit - ~6.3 cash opex (resource tax, admin, R&D, selling) + 7.4 D&A; rising to ~18.5% as volume growth leverages fixed costs against ~3%/yr cost inflation from mine depth. FY2025 clean EBITDA was ~CNY21.0bn (20.1%) and H1 2026 ~CNY13.0bn (24%) at peak prices.
base.capex_rationale: FY2025 CAS capex CNY12.9bn (1.8x D&A), H1 2026 5.9bn (1.8x). Path: 12.0bn FY2026, 11.5bn FY2027 (Twin Hills build, Sanshandao 15kt/d, Jiaojia/Xincheng integration), stepping down to ~1.05x D&A from FY2031 as projects complete. History has never had capex below 1.8x D&A, so the terminal ratio is generous to the company.
base.narrative: Gold normalises to ~US$3,000/oz from 2027 and stays flat in real terms; domestic production recovers to the 49t plan in 2027 after the 2026 safety-driven integration work, overseas keeps growing (Twin Hills first gold H1 2027), reserve replacement continues at ~1x depletion, and growth capex tapers so that by the terminal year the company is a ~60t producer spending ~1.05x D&A. The equity is a thin, levered residual: at this gold price the mid-cycle enterprise value roughly equals net debt plus perpetual bonds, so almost all of the market price is gold-price optionality rather than discounted mid-cycle cash flow.

bull.narrative: The 2025-26 gold regime holds: central-bank de-dollarisation and fiscal-credibility demand keep gold ~US$3,800/oz (CNY ~860/g) from 2027, ~17% below the H1 2026 realised price. Production recovers faster (50t in 2027, 55t by 2029, 60t+ by 2032) with Twin Hills, Sanshandao 15kt/d approval and Cardinal expansion; self-produced gross margin ~49%, consolidated EBITDA ~CNY24bn rising to ~33bn. D&A and capex are lower as a % of revenue because the revenue line is inflated by the higher pass-through price; in CNY they are the same ~7-12bn as the base. Capex tapers to ~1.06x D&A. Bull still needs two independent things: the gold price AND the domestic recovery.

bear.narrative: Fed credibility is restored and safe-haven demand fades: gold reverts to ~US$2,500/oz (CNY ~565/g, the 2024 level) from 2027 while cost per gram keeps rising ~3%/yr with depth, compressing the self-produced gold margin to ~CNY115/g. The safety-driven domestic shutdowns run into 2027 (40t in 2026, 45t in 2027) and the SOE keeps spending on integration and acquisitions near 1.1x D&A rather than cutting capex. EBITDA falls to ~CNY8-9bn against CNY67bn of debt and CNY14bn of perpetuals: owner FCF is roughly zero for the decade and the enterprise value does not cover the senior claims. For an ordinary shareholder the value in this path is bounded at zero by limited liability (plus the option value of a later gold recovery and SOE parent support); a negative modelled figure should be read as zero.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle gold ~US$3,000/oz from 2027, flat real; domestic output back to the 49t plan in 2027, Twin Hills first gold H1 2027, ~60t by 2035; capex tapers from 1.8x to ~1.05x D&A; 28% NCI leakage persists. Enterprise value at this price roughly equals net debt plus perpetual bonds, leaving ordinary equity as a thin residual.
scenario_narratives.bull: Gold ~US$3,800/oz sustained (the 2025-26 regime minus ~17%), production recovers to 50t in 2027 and 60t+ by 2032, self-produced gross margin ~49%, EBITDA ~CNY24-33bn, capex tapers to ~1.06x D&A. Requires both the gold price and the domestic recovery.
scenario_narratives.bear: Gold reverts to ~US$2,500/oz (2024 level), costs keep inflating with depth, domestic disruption runs into 2027, capex stays ~1.1x D&A; EBITDA ~CNY8-9bn cannot service CNY81bn of debt-like claims and the equity value is bounded at zero.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the equity is a levered residual (net debt + perpetuals ~CNY67bn against mid-cycle EBITDA ~CNY15-18bn, ~3.7x), 2026 production is disrupted with the full-year impact undetermined, 64.5% of sales go through a single exchange, and SOE capital allocation (dilutive placing, Donghai loss, peak-cycle acquisitions) is not run for minority holders. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs the 2025-26 gold regime to persist AND the domestic recovery. Gold price is the single dominant axis and the distribution around it is roughly symmetric, so bear and bull are weighted equally.
probability_weighted.bear_floor_note: The bear scenario's modelled equity value is negative (enterprise value below net debt + perpetual bonds). An ordinary shareholder's value in that path is bounded at zero by limited liability; the engine does not floor equity, so the canonical weighted_iv carries the negative bear figure. weighted_iv_equity_floored_hkd re-weights with the bear at zero and is the figure to read as the house view; both say the market price is several times mid-cycle intrinsic value.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on a mid-cycle gold price, built from the first pass rather than carrying FY2025/H1 2026 peak-cycle margins forward. Three things dominate: (1) the gold price - every US$500/oz is ~CNY5.5bn of self-produced gross profit on ~50t; (2) capital intensity - capex has run 1.8-5.5x D&A for eight years, so reported FCF has been negative in six of them and the company has funded growth with CNY60bn of new debt, perpetuals and equity; (3) leakage - 30% tax, 28% NCI and CNY14bn of perpetuals sit ahead of ordinary holders. At US$3,000/oz the enterprise value roughly covers the debt-like claims and little else; at US$3,800 the DCF lands near the market price; at US$2,500 the equity is out of the money. The market price is therefore best read as the price of a levered call on gold staying above ~US$3,500, not as a discount to mid-cycle cash flow. House rules applied: terminal value capped at 15x FCF (12x bear) for a cyclical, hurdle entry price with terminal rebuilt at 15%, risk charged in flows and weights rather than in WACC.
key_risks_to_valuation: Gold price regime: the base case takes a ~25-35% haircut to the 2025-H1 2026 realised prices; if US$4,000+ is the new normal the bull case understates value, and if gold reverts to 2024 levels the equity is impaired
Capex/D&A terminal ratio of ~1.05x has never been achieved historically (1.8x+ every year); if the SOE keeps acquiring at the top of the cycle the terminal FCF is overstated
NCI leakage at 28%: overseas growth through Shanjin International (71% minorities) and Veladero (50%) raises it; 100%-owned Twin Hills and Sanshandao lower it
Accounting basis switch (IFRS to CAS at FY2025) and the mid-2026 H1 numbers: FY2026 H2 is a judgment, not data; management says the full-year production impact of the safety work is undetermined
RMB appreciation compresses CNY-realised gold prices independently of the USD gold price; the model is in CNY

A-share premium and SOE support: the A-share trades ~40% above the H-share; parent stake purchases and SOE financing access mean the bear case is unlikely to become a solvency event even though the DCF equity is negative there
